packageRules.description: Breaking upgrades tracked in dedicated PRs: der (0.7→0.8 OctetStringRef DST change), rand (0.8→0.10 thread_rng/OsRng API changes). Remove this rule when each upgrade PR lands.

sha2 and digest are capped below 0.11 — opaque-ke 4.x requires the digest 0.10 trait family. Patch updates within 0.10.x still flow through. When upgrading opaque-ke to a digest-0.11-compatible version, update this allowedVersions in the same PR.
hkdf is capped below 0.13 — opaque-ke 4.x requires hkdf 0.12 (digest 0.10 trait family). Patch updates within 0.12.x still flow through. Update in the same PR as the opaque-ke upgrade.
